name: CRT Scanlines
desc: Retro CRT overlay: horizontal scanlines with barrel-darkened corners, a glass sheen, and rolling refresh bands that sweep down the tube; aperture-grille and VHS-tracking variants included.

style.doc: aesthetic: horizontal scanlines / vertical RGB aperture grille (abstract) / RGB dot-triad shadow mask (abstract) / degraded VHS tracking tear + chroma bleed + dropouts
